name: 15-Minute Liquidity Grab + 1-Minute Confirmation
setup_rules: Mark swing highs and swing lows on the 15-minute ETH chart.
Wait for price to grab liquidity from either side.
Downside liquidity grab: price moves below a 15-minute swing low.
Upside liquidity grab: price moves above a 15-minute swing high.
After the liquidity grab, move to the 1-minute timeframe for confirmation.
entry_rules: Buy setup: after a downside liquidity grab, wait for a green 1-minute candle.
Then wait for the next green candle (two consecutive green candles).
Enter BUY when the second green candle breaks AND closes above the first green candle high.
Sell setup: after an upside liquidity grab, wait for a red 1-minute candle.
Then wait for the next red candle (two consecutive red candles).
Enter SELL when the second red candle breaks AND closes below the first red candle low.
Size lots so one stop-loss risks 1% of the wallet (capped at 20 lots).
exit_rules: Take profit from the fill: the larger of 15 points and 2.5R.
Stop loss: first confirmation candle wick, only if it is 5–10 points from the fill.
If price reaches 1R, move the stop to breakeven.
risk_rules: Risk 1% of wallet per trade. Never size above 20 lots.
Stop trading for the day after a 3% daily loss, or after 3 full stop-losses.
Skip entries where the stop is tighter than 5 points (noise) or wider than 10 points.
Require at least a 3-point liquidity sweep beyond the 15-minute swing.
Require at least 2R after the actual fill.
Only take longs when the last 12 closed 15-minute bars (3 hours) are up; only take shorts when they are down.
Trade only during 08:00–20:00 UTC. Maximum 4 trades per day.
Do not reuse a 15-minute swing after it has already been traded.
If confirmation does not appear within 12 one-minute bars, cancel the grab.
Load 7 extra days of candles before the test window so swings and trend match longer lookbacks.
